correctness.rationale: For even m>=2 and u>-2 the denominator is strictly positive on the real axis. Exact differentiation reduces the off-origin problem to positive roots of S_{m,u}. Its discriminant factors as (u^2-4)q_m(u^2); q_m is negative for m=2,4 and has exactly one positive t>4 root for m>=6. The u=2 repeated root is negative, while all three large-u roots are positive for m>=6. Continuity proves all regimes and the genuine positive double root. Exact local expansions prove central multiplicities, the |u|^{1/m} origin approach and the square-root fold coefficient. An independent exact symbolic checker confirms identities and finite Sturm examples; the proof does not extrapolate finite tests.

At degree 12 a new four-critical-point pair creation becomes possible, with an explicit universal radical threshold depending on degree, and the zero-collision mechanisms have distinct and sharp exponents 1/m and 1/2.
